source.@value:
pipeline "UniFi GIM"
stage 0 match all
  rule "UniFi - detect mixed format"
stage 10 match either
  rule "UniFi - parse CEF"
  rule "UniFi - parse device syslog header"
stage 20 match either
  rule "UniFi - normalize CEF client events"
  rule "UniFi - normalize device syslog families"
stage 30 match all
  rule "UniFi - normalize severity to GIM"
stage 40 match all
  rule "UniFi - route normalized messages"
stage 41 match either
  rule "UniFi - route unsupported messages"
  rule "UniFi - route CEF messages"
  rule "UniFi - route syslog messages"
end

source.@value:
rule "UniFi - route syslog messages"
when
  has_field("unifi_log_format") && to_string($message.unifi_log_format) == "syslog"
then
  route_to_stream(name: "UniFi - Syslog", remove_from_default: false);
end
